subject: Activation signer lifecycle & operator acceptance — Delta Labs (disconnected cluster)
body:
From: Marta Ruiz <ops@delta-labs.com>

Cc: 
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 17:12:03 +0100
Subject: Activation signer lifecycle & operator acceptance — disconnected cluster

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are preparing the disconnected site at our Frankfurt facility and need to lock down the activation path for signed images and operator acceptance. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm signer rotation process (what keys are needed, minimum quorum, rotation cadence).
- Clarify the manifest format Redwood expects for offline activation and whether we can include an external HSM/BYOK fingerprint.
- Procedure for operator acceptance (operator signs off, evidence captured, and handback to Redwood).
- Activation window and fallback: how a staged activation/roll-forward looks in practice.

Attached is our initial requirements PDF (delta_deploy_requirements.pdf) with the facility's constraints (no outbound egress, courier-only media). Can you propose a draft activation flow we can walk through?

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Infrastructure, Delta Labs
ops@delta-labs.com

-----
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <ops@delta-labs.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 17:42:11 +01:00
Subject: Re: Activation signer lifecycle & operator acceptance — disconnected cluster

Marta — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. We can support your constraints; below is a concise draft flow for an air‑isolated activation path.

Draft activation flow (high-level):

1) Pre-shipping (prep):
   - Create a signed manifest (SHA256 per artifact) and a signer roster. Redwood produces a signed envelope using our release-signing key.
   - If Delta is using BYOK/HSM, include the public key fingerprint in the manifest (we will validate the fingerprint during acceptance).

2) Key ceremony & custody:
   - Optional dual-sign model: Redwood primary signer + Delta operator signer. Minimum 1 Redwood signer + 1 Delta operator for activation. Quorum: 2-of-2 by default; can be 2-of-3 for high-availability.
   - Rotation cadence: recommend quarterly rotation with emergency rotation procedures documented.

3) Courier & handoff:
   - Courier delivers signed bundle + manifest. Operator inspects seals and signs a handback receipt. Photo/scan of seals is retained as evidence.

4) On-site operator acceptance:
   - Operator performs offline verification steps (hash checks, vendor signature verification against roster) using a validated acceptance tool. Operator attaches their acceptance signature to the manifest (delta_public_keys.txt can be used to register operator keys).
   - Operator records a signed acceptance log; Redwood provides a JSON schema for the acceptance log we can include in the playbook.

5) Activation window & staged roll-forward:
   - Activation is scheduled (32–96 hour window recommended). In case of failure, roll-forward policy: revert to previous image using on-site snapshot; operator and Redwood support initiate rollback.

6) Audit & evidence handback:
   - After activation completes, operator hands back signed acceptance artifact and evidence (photos, signed manifest). Redwood collates this into the customer audit package (SOC2 evidence if requested).

Action items:
- Kimberly: I’ll need the acceptance-log JSON schema and the small playbook PDF attached to this thread (see redwood_activation_playbook_v1.pdf).
- Jordan: confirm whether our release key signing supports external HSM fingerprint verification out of the box and any extra steps for BYOK.

We should run a dry‑run before shipping. Proposed meeting: Tue 19 May, 09:30 CEST. Does that work for you?

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <ops@delta-labs.com>

Tessa — that looks good. A few clarifications from our side:

- We need to use our HSM slot for operator keys (FIPS 140-2 validated HSM). The manifest should carry both the HSM public key fingerprint and a CRL/expiry field.
- Quorum: we prefer a 2-of-3 model (2 signatures required from a roster of 3 possible signers) to allow for availability in operations.
- Audit package: please include the exact evidence items Redwood will store for SOC2 (we’ll need that for our audit prep).

Confirming Tue 19 May 09:30 CEST works. We’ll invite our on-site operations lead to the call.

Attached: delta_public_keys.txt (public keys exported from our HSMs)

Thanks,
Marta
